# CDNPurgeCommand Data Source Example

  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    xcsh = {
      source  = "f5-sales-demo/xcsh"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"

}

  name      = "example-cdn-purge-command"
  namespace = "staging"
}

output "cdn_purge_command_id" {
  value = data.xcsh_cdn_purge_command.example.id
}
